core_mechanism_bullets: English ascending-bid auctions raise prices openly until one bidder remains, whereas Dutch descending-clock auctions drop price until first claim.
Vickrey second-price sealed-bid auctions award the lot to the highest bidder at the price bid by the second-highest competitor.

bespoke_clusters.rule_of_thumb_mnemonic: Under UCC Section 2-328, an auction sale is 'with reserve' by default unless explicitly announced beforehand as an 'absolute' auction without reserve.
core_mechanism_bullets: Under UCC Section 2-328, an auction sale is 'with reserve' by default unless explicitly announced beforehand as an 'absolute' auction without reserve.
A binding contract forms at the fall of the hammer ('Sold!'), and if a bid arrives while the hammer is falling, the auctioneer may reopen bidding.
bespoke_clusters.worked_field_example: In an absolute auction without reserve, the consignor legally must sell the item to the highest bona fide bidder regardless of how low the final bid is.
